messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: capacity_saturation (prod) triggered for service 'inference-router' — 95th queue_depth > 120 for 3m; throttle_events spike detected. alert_id=cap-1234
mat_oncall: On it. I see increased token/sec and sustained queue depth on eu-west-1 pools. Starting triage.
alice_sre: Mat — are customers impacted? Any 5xx?
mat_oncall: Short answer: yes, ~0.4% error spike (502/504) and elevated latencies for requests > 1024 tokens. A few customers reported degraded completions.
sam_platform: Paging eng-sre rotation, assigning to @alice_sre and @mat_oncall. Can we check autoscale headroom?
alice_sre: Looking into autoscaler logs now. Quick snippet: ```json
{"pool":"eu-west-1-gpu-a","desired":12,"available":9,"queued":37,"throttle_count":213}```
carla_product: Heads up from CS: two enterprise customers (acme, greenbox) flagged timeouts in last 20m. They want an ETA.
mat_oncall: Mitigation options: 1) temporarily bump max replicas for eu-west pool 2) enable burst capacity 3) enable fallback to smaller model. Which do we want first?
alice_sre: Do 1 + 3 concurrently. Bump max replicas by +50% (safe) and flip non-critical traffic to model-compat small variant. I'll run the rollout.
mat_oncall: Doing terraform apply to increase max_replicas for eu-west pool. Command: ```bash
TF_VAR_region=eu-west-1 terraform apply -var 'pool=eu-west-1-gpu-a' -var 'max_replicas=18'```
alice_sre: I created a traffic rule to route model=redwood-large -> redwood-medium for non-committed customers: ```yaml
route_selector: "customer.tier != 'enterprise' && latency_budget < 400"
fallback_model: redwood-medium
rollout: canary 10% -> 50% -> 100%
```
monitoring-bot: INFO: autoscale action started, scaling to desired=18 for pool eu-west-1-gpu-a (runbook ref: rb-ops-7).
mat_oncall: Early signals: queue depth down ~30% in the last 6m, throttle_events falling. Latency p95 still elevated for long-tail.
sam_platform: We'll leave burst enabled for 30m and monitor cost. Please note: burst uses reserved capacity credits.
alice_sre: While we have page open — need to address alert noise. Current queue_depth alert: trigger when 95th > 80 for 3m. That's too sensitive during predictable diurnal spikes. Propose change: use 99th percentile and extend window to 5m, and add a throttling-events-count alert with a short debounce for real impact.
mat_oncall: Agreed. Concrete tuning: (A) queue_depth_alert: metric=queue_depth, agg=99th, threshold=100, window=5m, cooldown=10m; (B) tokens_per_sec_alert: metric=tokens/sec, agg=avg, threshold=700k, window=2m; (C) throttle_spike: metric=throttle_events, agg=sum, threshold=10, window=1m, debounce=1m -> page.
carla_product: Also add a dashboard panel called "autoscale health" that shows queue_depth (p50/p95/p99), tokens/sec, throttle_events, desired vs available replicas, and recent customer errors. Link to the panel in the postmortem.
alice_sre: I'll open a quick monitoring PR. Patch content (inline): ```yaml
alerts:
  - name: queue_depth_high_prod
    expr: quantile_over_time(0.99, queue_depth[5m]) > 100
    for: 5m
  - name: throttle_spike_prod
    expr: increase(throttle_events[1m]) > 10
    for: 1m
```
mat_oncall: Deployed the TF change and can confirm desired replicas reached 18. Bump helped. Throttle_events down to 12 -> 3 in 8m.
monitoring-bot: DASHBOARD UPDATE: autoscale-health panel created at https://console.redwood.example/d/dash-eu/autoscale-health?from=now-1h&to=now
alice_sre: Filing post-incident ticket: INC-7854 (follow-ups). Items: update alerts, add runbook section for burst vs reserve usage, add customer comms template, create long-tail latency investigation ticket for model large.
carla_product: CS: I'll send an update to affected customers with ETA ~1h for full stabilization. Thanks for the quick action. :thumbsup:
mat_oncall: Quick note for runbook change: add pre-emptive policy to convert non-enterprise traffic to small model when queue_depth > 150 for 2m (automated failover). We'll test in staging.
alice_sre: Agree. Also let's create a short-lived canary that exercises >1024 token requests to ensure pipeline kv-cache warmup doesn't amplify latencies.
sam_platform: Logging action owners: alice_sre -> monitoring PR + dashboard; mat_oncall -> runbook + burst config; carla_product -> customer comms; alice_sre & sam_platform -> long-tail latency root cause.
incident-bot: Incident severity downgraded: P2 -> P3. Reason: autoscale mitigated immediate capacity pressure; customer impact reduced.
mat_oncall: Closing the active page in 10m if signals hold. Will keep thread updated.
alice_sre: Follow-up: we'll schedule a short postmortem review tomorrow 10:00 PT. Agenda: timeline, alert tuning decisions, cost impact of burst, runbook edits.
mat_oncall: Last update: queue_depth p99 ~ 48, throttle_events=0, tokens/sec back to baseline. Closing page. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
